name: zrndr_set_perspective_texture_delta_x
description: zRndr::SetPerspectiveTextureDeltaX stores the requested perspective texture delta, clamps the working value to at least 8, and caches the derived power-of-two span and byte stride.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x490430 validates a leaf fastcall function that stores the original deltaX input, clamps the working value to at least 8, computes floor(log2(clampedDeltaX)) by arithmetic right shifts, stores the shift, stores 1 << shift, converts that integer to float, and stores the byte stride as pow2 * g_bytesPerPixel.

The native smoke verifies below-minimum clamping while preserving the original input, non-power-of-two floor behavior, exact power-of-two behavior, signed negative input preservation, float pow2 cache, and byte-stride derivation.

The data gate is accepted by zrndr_perspective_texture_setter_data: gRndr_PerspTextureDeltaXInput, gRndr_PerspTextureDeltaXPow2, gRndr_PerspTextureDeltaXShift, gRndr_PerspTextureDeltaXPow2F, gRndr_PerspTextureDeltaXBytes, and gRndr_BytesPerPixel all report zero unmasked data-byte mismatches.

VC5SP3 byte verification now passes for 0x490430 through zrndr_perspective_texture_setters with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking, 32 relocation-masked bytes, and 2 trimmed VC NOP bytes.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x490430 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 32 relocation-masked bytes and 2 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs; BN size 78, VC object symbol size 80.
